notes: Fastned's published charge curve for the Volkswagen ID.4 "77 kWh" (175 kW) (read from the page's embedded chart data, one value per % SoC; every 5 % kept plus the peak). Fastned states curves show the car with the battery in optimal condition (about 30 °C) on its 300 kW-class chargers; cold or hot batteries charge slower. European market car. Fastned shows the identical chart for the "GTX 77 kWh" (180 kW) listing, so it is one shared 77 kWh, 175-180 kW curve rather than a per-trim measurement. Peak 178.8 kW is 2.2 % above the 175 kW rating. Applied only to the 2024+ 175 kW powertrains; the 2023 Pro (170 kW rating) would exceed the 5 % ceiling by 0.3 kW so it is left out. Source range 3-89 %. Fastned lists identical data for the ID.4 77 kWh and the GTX, so the measured car is unknown; only weak second source (Cars.com ~30 min 10-80, curve integrates to 31.4 min).
